changes.workflow_job: dev-acceptance-stage in nonprod-deploy.yml, needs deploy-dev + coordinate-dev-release, runs only when coordinate-dev-release succeeded; continue-on-error job, advisory steps exit 0, no job depends on it, no rollback path; no lease-guard wrapper (a guarded step cannot be advisory); the qualification lease (pinned controller, mode qualification, copied from hosted-all12-chain-phase) is acquired only when acceptance/checks.json declares a mutating check
changes.runner: scripts/dev_acceptance_stage.py (plan | pending | run): built-in read-only deployed-pair-identity check, declared checks, probe discovery from acceptance/probes/; always exits 0, any internal or declaration error becomes a failed verdict owned by this task
changes.probe_contract: acceptance/README.md: executable read-only file per chain, '# acceptance-owner: <id>' header, exit 0 pass / 77 skip / other fail, env ACCEPTANCE_{BACKEND_SHA,FRONTEND_SHA,FE_URL,BFF_URL}; documented example probe in the README (no probe file shipped: outside the task artifact contract)
changes.verdict: pantheon.dev-acceptance-verdict.v1: acceptance pending|passed|failed, deployment SHAs, evidenceRun, checks[], failed[] with owner per failing check/probe; a mutating check skipped for lack of the lease keeps the verdict pending
changes.reporting: run summary lists deployed and acceptance separately; auto_deploy_dev_pair.py summary_lines reports 'deployed: pending' and 'acceptance: pending' for a dispatched run

storage_decision: The hosted verdict is a SIBLING file <dirname(DEV_DEPLOY_WORKTREE)>/acceptance/latest.json on the dev VM, not a field inside deployment.json: capture_frontend/verify_frontend pin manifest_sha256 and the dist digest, so editing the manifest or adding a file to the release directory would make verify_frontend report an exact artifact mismatch. This deviates from the literal 'inside the manifest' wording of the design (3.4) and is not served over HTTP; it is not verified against the real VM path or permissions from this worker (no hosted ssh) and the publish steps are continue-on-error.
growth_bound: one verdict file replaced via tmp+mv per release; per-check detail clipped to 2000 chars; at most 200 results; run artifact uses the existing 30-day retention
deploymentState: unchanged; its five readers and their tests were not modified (test_auto_deploy_dev_pair.py only gained a new test)
tests: scripts/test_dev_acceptance_stage.py (9), scripts/test_auto_deploy_dev_pair.py, scripts/test_dev_environment_lease_deploy_contract.py (new contract test), plus test_nonprod_dev_artifact_workflow.py, test_cross_repo_release_controller.py, tests/test_release_gate_contract.py: all passed
not_verified: the workflow job has not run on GitHub Actions; VM publish path and write permission are unverified; the step-6 execute-plans change and moving the existing in-script advisory checks into checks.json are separate tasks
residual_findings: Verdict is not readable over HTTP, so auto_deploy_dev_pair.py cannot yet show the previous release's acceptance; serving it needs an nginx/FE-release change outside this task.
The existing advisory checks of design 3.2 still run inside the deploy job; they must be declared in acceptance/checks.json when moved.
